source.name: OLBG Ice Hockey betting-tips index
source.method: HTTP GET of server-rendered HTML via urllib; no JavaScript execution
source.licence_note: Publicly viewable listing of facts (fixture, league, kickoff, tip counts) recorded for manual review. No bookmaker price is published in this HTML, so no price field is produced.

transcribed_from.name: OLBG Ice Hockey betting-tips index
transcribed_from.method: Fetched over HTTPS during review (HTTP 200). This sandbox has no outbound network for the collector itself, so the three event rows were transcribed into the reconstructed fixture at tests/fixtures/olbg_ice_hockey_index.RECONSTRUCTED.html and this file was generated from it by scripts/collect_ice_hockey_olbg.py.
transcribed_from.rows_verified: event ids 198599, 198658, 198655 with leagues, kickoffs and tip counts exactly as printed on the page
transcribed_from.will_be_replaced_by: the scheduled CI run of scripts/collect_ice_hockey_olbg.py, which fetches the live index directly

note: Display-and-join context for the ice hockey engine. OLBG publishes tipster consensus, not odds, so this slate can never supply a price; prices come from the ESPN scoreboard odds block (one book, attributed) and the NHL API is used for fixtures, standings and goaltending.
coverage_note: The live index showed three event rows and a "Load More Tips" control. data/olbg_sports.json counted four ice hockey events on the same day; the difference is recorded as IR-HOCKEY-06 rather than papered over.
